versions.name: Cow Creek Scout Reservation
versions.address: 2658 Cow Creek Rd, Blue Eye, MO 65611
versions.summary: An Ozark Trails Council campground on Table Rock Lake near Blue Eye in the Missouri Ozarks, used for troop and family campouts with waterfront activities including swimming, kayaking, canoeing, and small-boat sailing.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Ozark Trails Council's Cow Creek page. The source's Pony Express Council attribution is wrong: Cow Creek is an Ozark Trails Council property. Coordinates from scout-camp-map (approximate; US Census returned no match for the rural address); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified; camp_type/program_types classified from the council page as a short-term and family camping campground; coordinates approximate; features unsurveyed.
